answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 47134 Country: FJ Title: Azan Recitation Before Time Question: I am a Hafiz Quran and lead tarawih prayers at a local masjid. Yesterday there was a matter of concern so I thought to clarify: (1) If azan is recited 1 minute after the actual time starts then what is the ruling on it (i.e. is the azan to be repeated and is the azan valid)? Answer ID: 47134 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1414/1060/H=10/1434) You will have to repeat azan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
